title: Name it well
prompt: This robot code works, but `f` tells nobody what it does. Rename the function to `raise_shields`, both where it is defined and where run calls it. The output stays "Shields up".
hints: A good function name says what the function does, so the code reads like a sentence.
Change the name in two places: after func, and in the call inside run.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
